QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Slaka's Return
QuestInfo.0: You can hear someone shouting in the distance, and realize it's Slaka, the one who took food and left the caravan before. He's racing toward you with a pack of monsters hot on his heels.
QuestInfo.1: You can hear someone shouting in the distance, and realize it's Slaka, the one who took food and left the caravan before. He's racing toward you with a pack of monsters hot on his heels.
QuestInfo.2:
Slaka said he was halfway up the mountain to El Nath, but came back to tell you about the threat headed this way. He said something about a giant silhouette and a pink snowstorm. It's the same thing that happened near Kaptafel right before it was attacked.
He may have been exaggerating a bit, but his story was nearly identical to what you witnessed.
